findings.message: The handler panics when the `id` path value is not a valid integer, so any client can crash the request with a malformed URL. The rule asks handlers to log the error and return an error status instead; a bad id should get a 400.
findings.suggestion:
slog.Warn("delete widget: invalid id", "err", err)
		http.Error(w, "invalid widget id", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
